title: Canon's Phone App Is One of the Best. That Bar Is Low.
excerpt: DPReview tested Canon's Camera Connect app on iOS and Android. It is one of the better camera apps, with quirks on both platforms, and the best trick is a USB cable.

title: Take Fewer Photos. See More.
excerpt: James Popsys cut his daily shooting from thousands of frames to 250 on a Greenland trip and brought home better work. The cheapest cost of a frame is culling it.

title: Tamron's 20-40mm f/2.8 Comes to Nikon Z
excerpt: Tamron's compact 20-40mm f/2.8 wide zoom arrives for Nikon Z on October 22 for $729, giving full-frame shooters a light, fast wide-to-normal zoom with an unusual range.
